newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Bell Atlantic upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Bell Atlantic upgraded.

text.p: Brown Brothers Harriman analyst Robert Wilkes said Wednesday he had upgraded his short-term rating on Bell Atlantic Corp to market perform/buy from market perform/hold.
On Saturday, Bell Atlantic and NYNEX Corp said they would make concessions to the Federal Communications Commission designed to open their local markets to increased competition.
In return, a majority of FCC Commissioner said they planned to give the go-ahead to the merger of Bell Atlantic and NYNEX, perhaps as early as next week.
